nodes.description: Total token supply state variable declared in EIP20Interface; written in the EVM constructor.
Mapping of address to token balance; read and mutated by transfer, transferFrom and balanceOf.
Nested mapping of owner to spender to allowance; mutated by approve, increaseApproval, decreaseApproval and transferFrom.
Constant 2**256 - 1 used as the infinite-allowance sentinel in transferFrom.
Public token name string, set to EVAREIUM.
Public token symbol string, set to EVM.
Public constant token decimals, set to 18, used to scale the initial supply.
EVM constructor that mints the initial 150 million token supply and assigns it to msg.sender.
Transfers _value tokens from msg.sender to _to using SafeMath sub and add.
Transfers _value tokens from _from to _to, checking balance and allowance, decrementing allowance unless MAX_UINT256.
View function returning the token balance of _owner.
Sets the allowance msg.sender grants to _spender to _value.
View function returning the remaining allowance from _owner to _spender.
Increases the allowance msg.sender grants to _spender by _addedValue.
Decreases the allowance msg.sender grants to _spender by _subtractedValue, clamping at zero.
SafeMath multiplication with overflow assertion.
SafeMath integer division truncating the quotient.
SafeMath subtraction with underflow assertion.
SafeMath addition with overflow assertion.
msg.sender, the externally controlled caller address used as balance/allowance owner key.
Constructor state writes: totalSupply assignment and balances[msg.sender] = totalSupply.
balances[msg.sender].sub(_value) state mutation in transfer.
balances[_to].add(_value) state mutation in transfer.
require(balances[_from] >= _value && allowance >= _value) guard and allowance comparison against MAX_UINT256.
balances[_to].add(_value) state mutation in transferFrom.
balances[_from].sub(_value) state mutation in transferFrom.
allowed[_from][msg.sender].sub(_value) allowance decrement in transferFrom.
allowed[msg.sender][_spender].add(_addedValue) allowance increment in increaseApproval.
Allowance decrement or zero-clamp in decreaseApproval.
Unchecked raw multiply uint256 c = a * b inside SafeMath.mul before the overflow assert.
Raw subtraction a - b inside SafeMath.sub guarded by assert(b <= a).
Unchecked raw addition uint256 c = a + b inside SafeMath.add before the overflow assert.
Parameter _to of transfer, the recipient address.
Parameter _value of transfer, the amount of tokens to send.
Parameter _from of transferFrom, the address tokens are taken from.
Parameter _to of transferFrom, the recipient address.
Parameter _value of transferFrom, the amount of tokens to move.
Local variable allowance = allowed[_from][msg.sender] cached in transferFrom.
Parameter _owner of balanceOf whose balance is queried.
Return variable balance of balanceOf.
Parameter _spender of approve, the account granted the allowance.
Parameter _value of approve, the allowance amount granted.
Parameter _owner of allowance.
Parameter _spender of allowance.
Return variable remaining of allowance.
Parameter _spender of increaseApproval.
Parameter _addedValue of increaseApproval.
Parameter _spender of decreaseApproval.
Parameter _subtractedValue of decreaseApproval.
Local variable oldValue holding the current allowance in decreaseApproval.
Parameter a of SafeMath.mul.
Parameter b of SafeMath.mul.
Parameter a of SafeMath.div (dividend).
Parameter b of SafeMath.div (divisor).
Parameter a of SafeMath.sub (minuend).
Parameter b of SafeMath.sub (subtrahend).
Parameter a of SafeMath.add.
Parameter b of SafeMath.add.
allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = _value unconditional allowance overwrite in approve (classic approve race condition).

edges.reason: msg.sender determines which address receives the initial minted totalSupply in the constructor.
msg.sender is used as the balances key whose value is decremented in transfer.
msg.sender indexes allowed[_from][msg.sender] in the transferFrom require guard.
msg.sender indexes the allowance mapping decremented in transferFrom.
msg.sender is the owner key authorizing the allowance increase in increaseApproval.
msg.sender is the owner key authorizing the allowance decrease in decreaseApproval.
msg.sender is the allowance owner key written by approve.
transfer amount _value flows into balances[msg.sender].sub(_value).
transfer recipient _to is the key of balances[_to].add(_value).
transferFrom amount _value flows into balances[_to].add(_value).
transferFrom recipient _to is the key of the credited balance.
transferFrom source _from is the key of the debited balance.
Cached allowance local is compared against _value inside the require guard.
approve amount _value is written into the allowance mapping.
approve spender _spender is the inner key of the allowance write.
_addedValue flows into allowed[msg.sender][_spender].add(_addedValue).
_spender selects the allowance slot incremented in increaseApproval.
_subtractedValue flows into the allowance subtraction or the zero-clamp branch.
oldValue is compared with _subtractedValue and used in the subtraction branch.
First operand a flows into the raw multiplication in SafeMath.mul.
Second operand b flows into the raw multiplication in SafeMath.mul.
Minuend a flows into the raw subtraction in SafeMath.sub.
Subtrahend b flows into the raw subtraction in SafeMath.sub.
First operand a flows into the raw addition in SafeMath.add.
Second operand b flows into the raw addition in SafeMath.add.
The EVM constructor body executes the totalSupply and balances initialization writes.
transfer executes the balances[msg.sender] subtraction.
transfer executes the balances[_to] addition.
transferFrom executes the balance/allowance require guard.
transferFrom executes the credit to balances[_to].
transferFrom executes the debit from balances[_from].
transferFrom conditionally decrements the allowance when it is below MAX_UINT256.
approve executes the allowance mapping write.
increaseApproval executes the allowance addition.
decreaseApproval branches into the zero-clamp or subtraction allowance write.
SafeMath.mul executes the raw multiplication before the assert.
SafeMath.sub executes the raw subtraction.
SafeMath.add executes the raw addition.
Constructor writes the totalSupply state variable.
Constructor writes balances[msg.sender].
Constructor reads decimals to scale the initial supply.
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping.
transferFrom reads and writes the balances mapping.
transferFrom reads and writes the allowed mapping.
transferFrom compares allowance against MAX_UINT256.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
approve writes the allowed mapping.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
increaseApproval reads and writes the allowed mapping.
decreaseApproval reads and writes the allowed mapping.
transfer calls SafeMath.sub on balances.
transfer calls SafeMath.add on balances.
transferFrom calls SafeMath.sub for the debit and allowance decrement.
transferFrom calls SafeMath.add for the credit.
increaseApproval calls SafeMath.add on the allowance.
decreaseApproval calls SafeMath.sub on the allowance.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _to only exists to key the balances credit inside transfer, so it is folded into the transfer function node.
Parameter _value only flows into the transfer arithmetic, so it is folded into the transfer function node.
Parameter _from is used only within transferFrom as the debited account, so it merges into transferFrom.
Parameter _to is used only within transferFrom as the credited account, so it merges into transferFrom.
Parameter _value is used only within transferFrom, so it merges into transferFrom.
The allowance local is only read by the transferFrom require guard, so it merges into that unsafe operation.
Parameter _owner is used only to index balances in balanceOf, so it merges into balanceOf.
The balance return variable is produced solely by balanceOf, so it merges into balanceOf.
Parameter _spender is used only in the approve allowance write, so it merges into approve.
Parameter _value is written verbatim by the approve allowance assignment, so it merges into that unsafe operation.
Parameter _owner is used only to query the allowed mapping in allowance, so it merges into allowance.
Parameter _spender is used only to query the allowed mapping in allowance, so it merges into allowance.
The remaining return variable is produced solely by allowance, so it merges into allowance.
Parameter _spender only selects the allowance slot incremented in increaseApproval, so it merges into that unsafe operation.
Parameter _addedValue flows directly into the SafeMath add of the allowance, so it merges into that unsafe operation.
Parameter _spender only selects the allowance slot in decreaseApproval, so it merges into decreaseApproval.
Parameter _subtractedValue is compared and subtracted in the allowance update, so it merges into that unsafe operation.
oldValue holds the allowance read used by the decreaseApproval branch and subtraction, so it merges into that unsafe operation.
Operand a is used only in the SafeMath.mul multiplication/assert, so it merges into that unsafe operation.
Operand b is used only in the SafeMath.mul multiplication/assert, so it merges into that unsafe operation.
Operand a is used only by the SafeMath.div quotient computation, so it merges into the div function node.
Operand b is used only by the SafeMath.div quotient computation, so it merges into the div function node.
Operand a is used only in the SafeMath.sub subtraction/assert, so it merges into that unsafe operation.
Operand b is used only in the SafeMath.sub subtraction/assert, so it merges into that unsafe operation.
Operand a is used only in the SafeMath.add addition/assert, so it merges into that unsafe operation.
Operand b is used only in the SafeMath.add addition/assert, so it merges into that unsafe operation.
